style: Live-action, cinematic, overhead sodium strip lights

description.text: Live-action, cinematic medium-wide view inside a concrete road tunnel, the long barrel of the bore receding into darkness with sodium strip lights running overhead in a hard repeating rhythm. The

sits stopped and unlit in deep shadow, its carbon fibre body holding only thin amber traces along the roofline, the front wing and the lip of the wheel arch, while poolings of light draw bright bands across the damp concrete floor beneath it. The

comes around the front of the car and crosses the frame from left to right at an even walking pace, one hand trailing near the near-side headlamp, red jacket catching the strip lights as the figure passes the darker intervals between them. As the figure clears the front of the car, the headlamps ignite and the nose lifts slightly under acceleration, the body rocking back on its suspension before it rolls forward out of the shadow and into the pools of sodium light toward the camera, the bonnet and screen gaining a wet amber sheen as the tunnel darkness peels away behind it.
shrouded in shadow under overhead sodium strip lights in a concrete road tunnel, the floor damp and reflective.
Tunnel ambience with a faint electrical hum from the strip lights, a wide hollow reverberance around it.
steps around the front of the car and walks frame left to right, passing through the alternating bands of amber light and shadow.
Footsteps echoing flatly on concrete, spaced to the figure's steady walking pace.
The headlamps flare on, throwing two hard cones of light down the tunnel and lighting the concrete ahead.
A low engine growl rises as the car is brought up on revs.
rocks back on its suspension and pulls forward out of the darkness toward the camera, amber highlights sliding along the carbon fibre bodywork.
rolls fully into the sodium light, bonnet and windscreen taking on a wet amber sheen while the tunnel behind it recedes into unlit black.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
